question: Should maintainers accept the focused runner/Codex regression proof for this bot replacement, or require live Codex app-server wedge proof before merge?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix, but the linked incident is user-visible channel silence and the PR is already paused by a human-review/proof-decision marker.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Reconcile the branch with current main, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the focused same-session lane-release regression as sufficient for this narrow runner contract.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until Crabbox or live proof shows a timed-out Codex app-server cleanup releases the lane without corrupting session state or delivery.

options.title: Stop This Replacement
options.body: Close or stop the replacement if maintainers do not want to pursue proof or merge-risk ownership for this lane-release fix.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Reconcile the branch with current main, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the focused same-session lane-release regression as sufficient for this narrow runner contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Codex and runner work makes steipete the best available routing owner for the proof and rebase decision.
